verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no automations feature in Bolt.new, such as scheduled or triggered workflows, so there is nothing automation-specific to version, review, or roll back. GitHub backup with full change history and community mentions of reverting cover project code, not automations. Skills and the Prompt Library are reusable instructions with no documented versioning or rollback. These are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
